items.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer. The interviewee, Jason Palmer, does not mention any personal interaction, relationship, or specific knowledge of Monk Rowe beyond the context of the interview itself.

ctx.x: Jason was interviewed via Zoom on May 2, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Jason Palmer with me this morning, 9:30 AM. Used to be that jazz musicians didn’t know about 9:30 AM.

Right? Yeah. Either coming home from a gig or, you know, if you look at those like really consequential Blue Note records, a lot of those were started, you know, they started recording at that time. And you know I met Fred — well I’ll just start off with a story. I met Freddie Hubbard back in the late ‘90s and he told me a lot of those records that they made, you know, were recorded in the morning and so there were times when they would play a gig and they’d play several sets and it’d end at 3, 4, 5 in the…
